scenario_name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: Senior Residential Care (RSA)
initial_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I need a property with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 30 people. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
submitted_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I need a property with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 30 people. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Hotels, pensions, and similar',
    'Residential (Temporary/Holiday)',
    'Commercial activities and similar'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND healthcare >= 80.08
ORDER BY
  id ASC
